summary: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-domiciled blank-check company trading on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K disclosing an October 12, 2026 unsecured promissory note of $65,000 issued to sponsor Hwei Super Speed Co., Ltd. The advance funds a one-month extension of the business-combination deadline from October 13 to November 13, 2026. The note is non-interest bearing, matures at closing, is forgiven if no deal occurs, and is optionally convertible at $10.00 per unit. Watch for further extensions, dilution, and redemption levels as the SPAC clock runs.
